text: dsh-attention-router 是一款供 DSH 使用的事件注意力路由插件，通过注册 notify_classify 和 notify_policy 两个工具，把事件分成 alert、decide、inform 三类。分类器根据内置或用户提供的字面规则匹配文本，并处理否定词；未匹配的事件会进入待审决策类别。插件将 alert 立即交付，将 decide 排入人工审核，将 inform 仅记录，也可配置为摘要通知；重复告警可按冷却时间去重。适合希望减少日常完成消息打扰、同时保留故障和人工决策提醒的 DSH 用户。规则、路由策略和去重选项可在插件配置中调整。

dsh-attention-router classifies event text with built-in or custom literal rules. It sorts events into alert, decide, and inform tiers; unmatched events go to review. Alerts are delivered, decisions queued, and routine information logged or sent as a digest. A cooldown deduplicates repeated alerts.
想把故障、待我决定的事项和普通完成消息分开处理。
DSH 的日常通知太多了，能否只把重要事件推到我面前？
Can I route failures for immediate attention, decisions for review, and routine updates to a quiet log?
dsh-attention-router 的功能「事件分级路由」：按规则将事件分为告警、待决或信息，分别立即交付、排队审核或静默记录。调用 notify_classify 并提供事件文本即可获取分类和路由结果。
dsh-attention-router 的功能「查看当前通知策略」：通过 notify_policy 工具查看当前策略、各类规则数量、规则来源和警告信息，便于了解生效中的分类设置。

dsh-attention-router README · dsh-attention-router：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-attention-router) [](LICENSE)

> Author: jetpan (npm) ↔ jerentpan-lab (GitHub) | [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-attention-router) | [GitHub repo](https://github.com/jerentpan-lab/dsh-attention-router) | install from GitHub: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:jerentpan-lab/dsh-attention-router`

Stop agents from over-notifying. Classify every event into one of three tiers and route it:

dsh-attention-router README · dsh-attention-router：| tier | meaning | action |
|---|---|---|
| `alert` | fault, failure, data loss, rollback trigger | deliver now |
| `decide` | requires a human decision (approval, deletion, production change) | queue for review |
| `inform` | completed work, records, metrics | log only (silent) |

This is the "attention is the bottleneck" pattern: agents should only interrupt a human
for alerts and decisions, not for every completed step.

dsh-attention-router README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-attention-router
```

dsh-attention-router README · Tools：- `notify_classify` — classify text, return `{ tier, matched, action, notify }`
- `notify_policy` — show current policy and rule counts

  "rulesFile": "~/.dsh/attention-rules.json",
  "rulesFileWatch": true,

dsh-attention-router README · Config (0.2.0)：- `rulesFile`: external JSON rules (`{alert?: string[], decide?: string[], inform?: string[]}`); missing file falls back to defaults with a warning; `rulesFileWatch: true` hot-reloads on change.
- `dedupe.stateFile`: persists cooldown state across restarts (atomic write; corrupt state is quarantined with a warning).
- Unknown keys, unknown tiers and invalid values throw a readable `ConfigError`.
- Example: `config.example.json`. Run `npm run verify` for tests + pack-content/size/safety checks.
dsh-attention-router README · Bench：`node bench/bench.mjs` writes `bench/RESULTS.md` (this host: 1000 classify p50 ≈ 19.8ms, 10000 ≈ 184.9ms).

dsh-attention-router README · Troubleshooting (error table)：| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `ConfigError ... unknown key` | typo/unsupported config key | use keys from `config.example.json` |
| `ConfigError ... rules.<tier>` | tier not alert/decide/inform | fix tier name |
| `ConfigError ... dedupe.cooldownMs` | negative/NaN number | use a finite number >= 0 |
| `rulesFile not found` warning | external rules path missing | keep defaults or fix path |
| `rulesFile: invalid JSON` | malformed rule file | validate JSON |
| `dedupe state unreadable` warning | state file corrupt | it is ignored; delete it to reset |
| `rule conflict` warning | same literal in multiple tiers | keep the pattern in one tier only |

dsh-attention-router README · Verify：```bash
npm run verify   # unit tests + npm pack content/size/safety checks
```
